segments: The Chronography of Barhebraeus.
[Page] 324. went to attack a certain village of the Armenians,
Stephen, the brother of Thoros, gathered the Armenians,
and they came by night and hid in the houses of the Armenians.
And in the morning, when the gate of the fortress was opened,
they leapt up and entered,
and seized the gate and the outer wall,
and began to dig [a way] through to those inside.
And suddenly terror fell upon them,
saying that the Emir and a multitude of the Turks were arriving.
And when they were afraid
lest they be trapped between the two walls,
and that there would be fighting against them from both the inside and the outside,
they plundered the city,
and set fire to the houses and to whatever they were unable to carry off,
and took all the people into captivity and fled.
And in that captivity, the bishop Mor Dionysius bar Salibi was also carried off by the accursed Armenians;
and on foot he escaped to the monastery of Qalesyur (Qalesyud; Basil).
And he composed three metrical homilies on this devastation of Mar'ash,
because it was his diocese at that time.
Now the Turks, when they arrived,
treated with mercy the Christians who were left.
And to everyone of the Armenians who had fled and came [back],
they did not withhold from him his houses, his vineyards, and his lands.
However, a certain Armenian priest,
on the pretext that he was communicating with the Armenians,
they flayed alive,
and after three days they cut off his tongue, his hands, and his feet,
and burned him with fire.
And the Armenians too, when they heard of this,
did the very same thing to certain Turks.
And in that year also in Melitene, another priest, likewise an Armenian, was flayed alive,
because he enticed a young girl from the neighborhood who was newly betrothed,
and brought her into the church,
and desired to commit fornication with her.
And when that wretched girl began to scream,
the defiled man put his hand over her mouth,
until he had completed his shameful act.
And when he got up from her,
he found her at her last gasps.
Then he strangled her completely,
and cut off her ears and some {OCR?} of her fingers,
because they had swollen,
and the rings, bracelets, and anklets {OCR?} would not come off;
and he hid them inside the hanging lamps.
And her corpse he wrapped in a curtain,
and placed inside the sanctuary.
